pulse.currentFocus: Phase 0-2 of the finalization plan shipped and verified live at 57e69bfcd: registration works again (an undefined VS.kitSubscribe had failed every signup while creating the account), a taken handle no longer reads as success, /login serves browsers a page instead of JSON, the funnel separates bots from people, and subscriptions have a working cancel path. Next: the human signup walkthrough that is the plan's actual Phase 0 gate, then Phases 3-7 (adaptive front door, activation instrumentation, welcome email, the three divergent rank ladders).
pulse.nextMilestone: A human completes a signup in a clean browser profile with the subscribe box checked and lands on the dashboard - the only evidence that closes Phase 0.
blockers: [QA/P0] The Phase 0 gate is a human walkthrough and has not been run. The registration fix is verified by build:check 388/388, mobile 215/215, worker 57/57 and by reading the SERVED bundle - but not by a person creating an account.

[SEC/P0] The gateway's Supabase service-role key is scoped to a different project (ref ckwtolofoqzrqouqkmvs; this site ships fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp). It 401s on first use while check-secrets reports READY 2/2. This is a second, independent reason the Obelisk provider ceremony would fail - after the founder completes the passkey flow. Fix belongs in studio-ops via Ark cargo (CANON-018).
[AUTH/P0] The Obelisk provider journey remains unobserved. Use --watch, not --live.
[VOICE/P1] The homepage IGNIS chip published 'The studio keeps resync after publisher race' to strangers - CI jargon as the first sentence under the studio name.

now: [S343][AUTH/P0] Nobody could join this website — one undefined function was failing every registration. DONE S343, live in production. `vault-member/portal-auth.js` called `VS.kitSubscribe(...)`, defined nowhere in the codebase, inside the registration try-block and BEFORE `showDashboard()`. The subscribe checkbox ships `checked`, so every new member on the default path hit a TypeError, was told *"Could not complete registration. Please try again."* — and was stranded while their account had in fact been created; the retry then collided with `register_open`'s username-uniqueness guard. This is the explanation for zero users. Opt-in now fires AFTER `showDashboard()`, guarded on `window.VaultKit`, un-awaited, rejection swallowed. Verified in the SERVED bundle at `57e69bfcd`: the only surviving `kitSubscribe` is the comment explaining its removal.

[S343][AUTH/P0] A taken Vault Handle was reading as a successful registration. DONE S343. `register_open` reports a rejection as DATA, not as `rpcErr`; the client checked only `rpcErr`, so a taken handle dropped the member into a dashboard their handle was never bound to. Now inspects `rpcData` on both the array and object shapes.

[S343][UX/P1] `/login` served browsers a raw JSON blob when the IdP was down. DONE S343. `cloudflare/obelisk-auth.js` content-negotiates: browsers get a branded retry page, machines keep the `identity_provider_unavailable` JSON contract byte-for-byte. 57/57 worker tests.

[S343][OBS/P1] The funnel had no bot separation, while the site advertised that it did. DONE S343. `/stats/ecosystem/` has claimed "bots separated from people" for months; the funnel beacon applied no such filter, leaving all 371 hero impressions of unknown provenance. `looksLikeBot()` returns a BOOLEAN — the UA is read and discarded, never stored, because a retained UA is a fingerprint.
